scope: Six corrected native controlled-flow checks. This is not the full requirement denominator or a usability score.
substitutions: substituted provider responses for explicit manual generation

manual_at_automatic_limit.provider_scope: one substituted text response and one substituted voice response; no real endpoint

failure_resume.observed: saved pause clears only after explicit Resume; named saved source error and recovery action visible

unavailable_and_empty_libraries.observed: actual selected library IDs read back after save; empty-list Retry after access grant reaches music

initial_selection_and_pending_library_sa.observed: saved two-library selection read back after music navigation; account switch/signout locked during save

continuous_first_use.observed: saved host/mood read back, decoded WAV time advances, opt-ins independent, restart paused, legacy DJ preference retained on edit; no provider calls

limits: no real provider requests or personal credentials
no observed listener usability or audible-quality score
